visualCharacteristics: Text-only stacked news list: date, large title link, abstract, right-aligned Read More
contentPattern: 4 news items with date, title, abstract, Read More — Dynamic list: each item links to a news detail page and carries a date; item set changes over time. No images, so a text-only cards variant.
usage: Text-only list of dated news items
authoring: One row per item: leave cell 1 empty (or add an image), date paragraph, linked title, abstract and Read More link in cell 2
reuseGuidance: Use for news/event listings with dates; use cards-feature for image-led promo tiles.
